data.summary:
AI Product Manager owning LLM output quality for a production tax-research and filing platform, where a wrong citation or
a wrong line on a return is a compliance risk rather than a UX bug. Built the full quality loop behind the product: a
self-maintaining 270K+-record primary-law corpus, human-expert golden datasets (Keystone benchmark; Project Evals - tax
analysts authoring 2,000 reviewed datasets), & the evaluation layer that turns both into shipped fixes. Also built
CrossSource , an open-source legal-RAG eval harness. Previously shipped a $2.7M MRR enterprise product.
